name: forge-3d
description: Forge: turn a picture, a drawing or a sentence into a 3D model (.glb + .obj in the workspace's models/), then look at it, sculpt it and export it in the Forge panel. Best first: TripoSR on this computer (CUDA ~6 GB on the PC, Apple MPS on the Mac, CPU slowly; set up with tools/setup_forge3d.py), then a free online Hugging Face Space (TRELLIS) when gradio_client is installed - the picture is then sent to that third party (never with LOKI_LOCAL_ONLY=1) - and always an offline 'lift' that inflates the cut-out silhouette into a rounded mesh. LOKI's make_3d tool.
license: MIT (TripoSR code and weights; TRELLIS; LOKI's lift is AGPL-3.0)
install: python tools/setup_forge3d.py   (torch + TripoSR, about 3 GB; or `online` for gradio_client only)
notice: The online fallback sends your picture to a Hugging Face Space (a third party). The offline lift needs nothing.
